title: Short MSA missing LoL with one-sided indemnity
instruction: Flag high-risk clauses in this agreement and cite the source text.
document:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

1. Parties
This Agreement is entered into between Acme Corp ("Provider") and Buyer LLC ("Customer").

2. Services
Provider shall provide software implementation services as described in Schedule A.

3. Indemnity
Customer shall indemnify and hold harmless Provider from any and all claims, damages, and expenses arising from Customer's use of the services, including third-party claims, without limitation.

4. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice. Provider may terminate immediately for convenience.

5. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Delaware.

6. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep confidential information secret for three years.
